page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.6xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on x86_64 architecture running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor, the server features 12 physical CPU cores supporting Hyper-Threading for a total of 24 dedicated vCPUs. It is configured with 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM allocation (2.0 GB per vCPU). Cache hierarchy includes 48 KB L1 data cache per core, 1 MB L2 cache per core, and 48 MB of shared L3 cache. Advanced instruction set support covers AVX-512 with VNNI extensions, AES, VAES, SHA_NI, BMI2, and FMA. The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps, while local instance storage is absent, requiring external network block storage for persistence.

Across standardized CPU and synthetic benchmarks, the instance demonstrates consistent mid-range performance relative to comparable cloud hardware profiles. Multi-core testing yields a PassMark CPU score of 29,354.86, a Geekbench multi-core score of 11,562, and a multi-threaded stress-ng result of 23,298.44. Memory bandwidth reaches up to 129.31 GB/sec for large block uncached reads and 63.06 GB/sec for writes. In application benchmarks, static web serving reaches 28.49 GB/sec throughput, and Redis SET operations register at 23.57 million operations per second. Hardware acceleration via vector extensions delivers top-tier throughput in small-scale machine learning tasks, such as text generation for 135M parameter LLM models at 298.93 tokens per second.

The resource ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU prioritizes compute density over memory capacity, making the server cost-efficient for core-bound computational workloads that do not require extensive RAM footprints. However, the lack of local NVMe storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which introduces potential network IOPS overhead for storage-heavy tasks. Suitable workloads include continuous integration and build compilation, batch data processing, web serving, and lightweight CPU-based machine learning inference.
